title: Device types and module types of the NetBox community device-type library
coverage: Complete for the library at the pinned commit: every device type and module type of every manufacturer in it. The library itself is community-maintained and does not hold every model of every manufacturer.
missing: Models the library does not hold (they can still be recorded, and are marked unverified)
Rack types and elevation images of the library (not used)

sources.name: NetBox community device-type library
sources.terms: CC0 1.0 Universal (LICENSE.txt at the pinned commit, read on the date above). No attribution is required; the source is named anyway.
sources.result: The index is built from the files at the pinned commit; a full definition is fetched from that same commit and checked against the SHA-256 in the index.
